title: Chef John’s Broiled Chicken
description: You don’t need to grill your chicken outdoors to get the intense flavor you want; just follow Chef John’s quick and easy flame broiler chicken recipe.
ingredients: 1 (3 pound) whole chicken, cut in half, backbone removed

steps.text: Preheat the oven broiler. Set an oven rack about 7 to 8 inches from the heat source.
Spread onion slices in a single layer on the bottom of a baking dish. Season chicken with salt. Place chicken halves skin-side down over onion rings.

Cook chicken in the preheated oven, turning every 7 minutes, until caramelized, no longer pink at the bone, and the juices run clear, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, near the bone, should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make juicy broiled chicken with perfectly crispy skin. Done correctly, broiled chicken can offer the same intense flavors as chicken from an outdoor grill. It’s a simple technique. The dry, high heat creates delicious charring and caramelizing. One of the keys here is to start with dry chicken. See how it’s done.
